# Seven Dwarfs

## Definition
The Seven Dwarfs are the group of characters in *Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs* who take in the heroine, protect her, and mourn her after she dies.

## Key Characteristics
- They shelter Snow White in their house (Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.pdf).
- They warn Snow White not to open the door to strangers (Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.pdf).
- They grieve Snow White's death by placing her in a glass coffin (Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.pdf).

## Context
The Seven Dwarfs appear within the narrative of *Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs*, where their actions of sheltering, warning, and mourning shape the story's central sequence of events (Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.pdf). Their role as a group of protectors gives the tale its name.
